say:1:1223105001:0.text: My goods are all over the ground! No one's going to buy them now!
say:1:1223105001:0.source_cn: 我的货……我的货！喔唷，全都掉到地上了！这下卖不出去了！

say:3:1223105002:0.text: Hey, did you do that on purpose?!
say:3:1223105002:0.source_cn: 喂！肮脏的水鬼，你们故意的是不是！

say:4:1223105003:0.text: I gave you a job, and this is how you repay my kindness?!
say:4:1223105003:0.source_cn: 我大发慈悲给你们工作的机会，你们就是这样回报我的？

say:5:1223105004:0.text: You've got the wrong idea, boss. It's all the Carmine Whispers' fault!
say:5:1223105004:0.source_cn: 这是误会，老板。都怪血薇帮，不然货也不会弄脏。

say:6:1223105005:0.text: Wrong idea indeed! I shouldn't have believed you when you offered to deliver the goods for free! So much for your promise on turning over a new leaf!
say:6:1223105005:0.source_cn: 误会？是啊！我误认为你们不收钱，是真的想改过自新！能把...

say:7:1223105006:1.text: *Sigh* I can only blame myself for being so naive!
say:7:1223105006:1.source_cn: 唉，算我倒霉！就不该相信水鬼还能改过自新！

say:10:1223105007:0.text: Wait a minute. You hired Water Wights?
say:10:1223105007:0.source_cn: 等一下，你雇佣了水鬼帮？

say:12:1223105009:1.source_cn: 什么！他们不是在打劫吗？

say:13:1223105010:0.text: These are my goods, and I asked the Water Wights to carry them. What are you talking about?
say:13:1223105010:0.source_cn: 这是我的货，我让他们搬的！打什么劫！

say:17:1223105011:0.text: See! We wanted to do a good deed, and people still thought we were stealing...
say:17:1223105011:0.source_cn: 真倒霉，好不容易良心发现想送个货，居然也被当做打劫……

say:19:1223105012:0.text: You can't blame the Carmine Whispers. After all, you guys are known for stealing and robbing.
say:19:1223105012:0.source_cn: 这也不能怪血薇帮吧，谁让你们一出现就是抢这抢那的。

say:20:1223105013:0.text: Everyone in Rustport is terrified of you!
say:20:1223105013:0.source_cn: 你们都已经成为锈锚港的阴影了！谁看到你们不害怕呢？

say:21:1223105014:0.text: You're right. Al's idea of having us find a job is terrible.
say:21:1223105014:0.source_cn: 你说的没错，阿尔让我们来找活干的主意真是糟透了。

say:24:1223105015:1.text: Hey! My goods are still on the ground!
say:24:1223105015:1.source_cn: 喂喂喂！我的货还在地上呢！

say:26:1223105016:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.
say:26:1223105016:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.
say:26:1223105016:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.

choice_prompt:27:1223105016.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.
choice_prompt:27:1223105016.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，您能帮忙吗？这些混蛋太让人不放心了。
choice_prompt:27:1223105016.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.
choice_prompt:27:1223105016.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you do me this favor? These rascals can't be trusted.

say:29:1223105017:0.source_cn: 咳咳，我们也来帮忙收拾吧。

say:32:1223105018:0.text: Of course! Being a knight is all about helping people!
say:32:1223105018:0.source_cn: 嗯，骑士有帮助人的美德！

say:33:1223105019:0.text: Thanks a million! Just put the goods back in their original place. *Sigh*... If anything's damaged, I'll just have to write it off as a loss.
say:33:1223105019:0.source_cn: 太感谢了，只要恢复原样就好，要是有货损我就自认倒霉了，唉……

say:1:1223107001:0.text: You did a fine job, Magister! I definitely need to treat you to a meal some time.
say:1:1223107001:0.source_cn: 整理得太棒了，有机会，一定让我招待您吃饭！
say:1:1223107001:0.male: You did a fine job, Magister! I definitely need to treat you to a meal some time.
say:1:1223107001:0.female: You did a fine job, Magister! I definitely need to treat you to a meal some time.

say:3:1223107002:0.text: Hmph! For Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I won't ask for compensation on my dirty and damaged goods.
say:3:1223107002:0.male: Hmph! For Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I won't ask for compensation on my dirty and damaged goods.
say:3:1223107002:0.female: Hmph! For Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s sake, I won't ask for compensation on my dirty and damaged goods.

say:4:1223107003:1.text: You all need to accept your fate. No one in Rustport's going to hire you!
say:4:1223107003:1.source_cn: 认命吧，你们在锈锚港不可能找到活的！

say:5:1223107004:1.text: I don't believe in fate! Blasted fish scales! If Al hadn't stopped us from stealing and robbing, we wouldn't be in this sorry state!
say:5:1223107004:1.source_cn: 老子偏不认命！要不是阿尔不让打砸抢，我们还用得着受这窝囊气？

say:6:1223107005:1.text: If anything, we'll just go back to doing what we used to do.

say:7:1223107006:1.text: I mean stealing and robbing count as a job too, right?
say:7:1223107006:1.source_cn: 打砸抢不也是一份工作吗？

say:10:1223107007:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet used to plunder this city. Now, their bones lie at the bottom of the sea.
say:10:1223107007:1.source_cn: 上一个在锈锚港打砸抢的死潮舰队，骨头已经沉到海底了。

say:11:1223107008:1.text: Don't forget who let you stay in Rustport in the first place, you dirty seadogs.
say:11:1223107008:1.source_cn: 混蛋们，别忘了是谁放你们进锈锚港的。

say:12:1223107009:1.text: Since we can let you in, we can also get rid of you for good.
say:12:1223107009:1.source_cn: 血薇帮既然可以放你们进来，也能让你们永远消失。

say:13:1223107010:1.text: That's funny! You think all of Rustport is your turf!
say:13:1223107010:1.source_cn: 真是笑话！别说的好像锈锚港是只属于你们的地盘一样。

say:14:1223107011:1.text: Turf? Only dogs care about marking this place and that. Making the whole place stink to high heaven!
say:14:1223107011:1.source_cn: 地盘？我印象里只有野狗特别在意地盘，它们到处撒尿，标记...

say:15:1223107012:1.text: My job is to keep an eye on these dumb dirty seadogs so they don't do that. You get what I'm saying, bub?
say:15:1223107012:1.source_cn: 而我的工作，是盯紧这些蠢狗不要到处撒尿，你明白我的意思吗？

say:16:1223107013:1.text: Are you talking me? You'd better watch your mouth!
say:16:1223107013:1.source_cn: 谁是蠢狗？嘴巴放干净点！

say:17:1223107014:1.text: Behave yourself if you don't want to be seen like a dumb mutt.
say:17:1223107014:1.source_cn: 不想做蠢狗，那就别在锈锚港乱来。

say:20:1223107015:0.text: Well said, Knox. Right now, all we want is a decent job and a normal life.
say:20:1223107015:0.source_cn: 您教训的是，我们现在只想好好找个活，挣点钱，过过正常生活。

say:23:1223107016:0.text: By "normal life", do you mean leaving the citizens terrified?
say:23:1223107016:0.source_cn: 你们的正常生活就是把居民吓得屁滚尿流？

say:24:1223107017:1.text: Hey, relax, buddy. We aren't here looking for trouble.
say:24:1223107017:1.source_cn: 放轻松，我们也不想惹事。

say:25:1223107018:1.text: We were even willing to work for free this time just to land a job.
say:25:1223107018:1.source_cn: 你瞧，为了找活，我们都愿意这单白干了。

say:26:1223107019:1.text: If we aren't welcome here, we'll leave.
say:26:1223107019:1.source_cn: 锈锚港不欢迎我们，我们会先离开。

say:29:1223107021:0.text: Alright, show's over, folks. It's time for everyone to go home.
say:29:1223107021:0.source_cn: 行了，没热闹可看了，大家都散了吧。

choice_prompt:30:1223107021.text: Alright, show's over, folks. It's time for everyone to go home.
choice_prompt:30:1223107021.source_cn: 行了，没热闹可看了，大家都散了吧。

say:31:1223107022:0.text: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We need your help!
say:31:1223107022:0.male: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We need your help!
say:31:1223107022:0.female: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We need your help!

say:32:1223107023:1.text: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.
say:32:1223107023:1.source_cn: 向肚子里的鱼发誓，我们绝不乱来，只是需要一个重新开始的机会。
say:32:1223107023:1.male: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.
say:32:1223107023:1.female: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.

choice_prompt:33:1223107023.text: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.
choice_prompt:33:1223107023.source_cn: 向肚子里的鱼发誓，我们绝不乱来，只是需要一个重新开始的机会。
choice_prompt:33:1223107023.male: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.
choice_prompt:33:1223107023.female: I swear on the fish in our bellies that we'll behave. We just need a chance to start afresh.

say:34:1223107024:1.text: Could I have a moment to speak with you?
say:34:1223107024:1.male: Could I have a moment to speak with you?
say:34:1223107024:1.female: Could I have a moment to speak with you?

choice:33:0:1.text: You should pray to the god of the waves.
choice:33:0:1.source_cn: 你应该去求风浪与漂泊之神
choice:33:0:1.male: You should pray to the god of the waves.
choice:33:0:1.female: You should pray to the god of the waves.

choice:33:1:2.text: You should ask for the Carmine Whispers' permission.
choice:33:1:2.male: You should ask for the Carmine Whispers' permission.
choice:33:1:2.female: You should ask for the Carmine Whispers' permission.

choice:33:2:3.text: Will the citizens give you a chance?
choice:33:2:3.source_cn: 民众愿意给你们机会吗
choice:33:2:3.male: Will the citizens give you a chance?
choice:33:2:3.female: Will the citizens give you a chance?

say:0:1223108001:0.text: It's hard to believe the Water Wights want to mend their ways!
say:0:1223108001:0.source_cn: 稀奇，水鬼居然也想重新开始！
say:0:1223108001:0.male: It's hard to believe the Water Wights want to mend their ways!
say:0:1223108001:0.female: It's hard to believe the Water Wights want to mend their ways!

say:1:1223109001:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the hero of Rustport now. We're hoping you could help us out a bit...
say:1:1223109001:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the hero of Rustport now. We're hoping you could help us out a bit...
say:1:1223109001:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the hero of Rustport now. We're hoping you could help us out a bit...

say:4:1223109002:1.text: No, the Magister can't risk his reputation. Who knows what tricks you might have up your sleeves?
say:4:1223109002:1.source_cn: 不行，主人的名誉不能借给你们，谁知道你们藏着什么坏心思？
say:4:1223109002:1.male: No, the Magister can't risk his reputation. Who knows what tricks you might have up your sleeves?
say:4:1223109002:1.female: No, the Magister can't risk her reputation. Who knows what tricks you might have up your sleeves?

say:5:1223109003:1.text: Sir, even though I feel sorry for you, I must say you brought this on yourselves with all the bad deeds you've done.
say:5:1223109003:1.source_cn: 先生，虽然你们看起来有一点可怜，但谁让你们之前干了那么...

say:6:1223109004:1.text: I can fully empathize with those traumatized citizens. As the saying goes, "What goes around comes around."
say:6:1223109004:1.source_cn: 我完全可以理解那些被你吓到的居民，有句话怎么说的，你们...

say:7:1223109005:1.text: I get it. Go ahead and dress us down; we've heard worse.
say:7:1223109005:1.source_cn: 唉，我明白。你们要骂就骂吧，更难听的我们也不是没听过。

say:8:1223109006:1.text: But can you hear me out after you're done?
say:8:1223109006:1.source_cn: 但是骂完之后，可以听我说一句吗？

say:9:1223109007:1.text: In fact, we're mending our ways for Rustport's sake too!
say:9:1223109007:1.source_cn: 其实我们想重新开始，也是为了锈锚港啊！

choice_prompt:10:1223109007.text: In fact, we're mending our ways for Rustport's sake too!
choice_prompt:10:1223109007.source_cn: 其实我们想重新开始，也是为了锈锚港啊！

say:13:1223109008:0.text: Can you come over? Let's speak in private.
say:13:1223109008:0.source_cn: 您过来，咱们站远一点，悄悄说。
say:13:1223109008:0.male: Can you come over? Let's speak in private.
say:13:1223109008:0.female: Can you come over? Let's speak in private.

say:14:1223109009:0.text: You caught what my crewmates said to the Carmine Whispers just now, didn't you?
say:14:1223109009:0.source_cn: 你刚才看热闹的时候，也听见我的弟兄们怎么和血薇帮说的吧？
say:14:1223109009:0.male: You caught what my crewmates said to the Carmine Whispers just now, didn't you?
say:14:1223109009:0.female: You caught what my crewmates said to the Carmine Whispers just now, didn't you?

say:18:1223109012:1.text: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!
say:18:1223109012:1.source_cn: 您都听到了吧？如果找不到活稳住这帮家伙，他们还想干回老本行！
say:18:1223109012:1.male: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!
say:18:1223109012:1.female: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!

choice_prompt:19:1223109012.text: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!
choice_prompt:19:1223109012.source_cn: 您都听到了吧？如果找不到活稳住这帮家伙，他们还想干回老本行！
choice_prompt:19:1223109012.male: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!
choice_prompt:19:1223109012.female: So, you did hear them. If they can't get a job, they'll return to their old tricks!

say:20:1223109013:0.text: Not at all! We'd never threaten someone who beat our boss!
say:20:1223109013:0.source_cn: 不不不，您把奈拉大姐头都制服了，我们哪敢威胁您？！
say:20:1223109013:0.male: Not at all! We'd never threaten someone who beat our boss!
say:20:1223109013:0.female: Not at all! We'd never threaten someone who beat our boss!

say:21:1223109014:0.text: If there's a way to survive, no one wants to risk their life.
say:21:1223109014:0.source_cn: 如果能求生，没人想找死。
say:21:1223109014:0.male: If there's a way to survive, no one wants to risk their life.
say:21:1223109014:0.female: If there's a way to survive, no one wants to risk their life.

say:22:1223109015:1.text: Actually, the Carmine Whispers let us in on the condition that we had to behave ourselves.
say:22:1223109015:1.source_cn: 其实血薇帮放我们进城，条件就是我们必须老实做个良民。
say:22:1223109015:1.male: Actually, the Carmine Whispers let us in on the condition that we had to behave ourselves.
say:22:1223109015:1.female: Actually, the Carmine Whispers let us in on the condition that we had to behave ourselves.

say:23:1223109016:1.text: Of course, those among us who committed more heinous crimes have all been captured.
say:23:1223109016:1.source_cn: 当然，那些杀人放火，罪孽深重的水鬼早都被血薇帮抓起来了。
say:23:1223109016:1.male: Of course, those among us who committed more heinous crimes have all been captured.
say:23:1223109016:1.female: Of course, those among us who committed more heinous crimes have all been captured.

say:24:1223109017:1.text: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?
say:24:1223109017:1.source_cn: 眼前你看到的这些人，包括我在内，都是手上没怎么沾过血的...
say:24:1223109017:1.male: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?
say:24:1223109017:1.female: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?

choice_prompt:25:1223109017.text: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?
choice_prompt:25:1223109017.source_cn: 眼前你看到的这些人，包括我在内，都是手上没怎么沾过血的。记得吗？我还给您修过船呢。
choice_prompt:25:1223109017.male: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?
choice_prompt:25:1223109017.female: The Water Wights you see here, including me, have hardly harmed anyone. Remember how I fixed your ship for you?

say:26:1223109018:0.text: Is that the island's name? I thought it was just a deserted island.
say:26:1223109018:0.source_cn: 那个岛还有名字吗？我还以为是个荒岛。
say:26:1223109018:0.male: Is that the island's name? I thought it was just a deserted island.
say:26:1223109018:0.female: Is that the island's name? I thought it was just a deserted island.

say:27:1223109020:1.text: We were stranded on the beach and you left us to repair your ship. That's when it occurred to me that maybe living honestly wasn't such a bad idea.
say:27:1223109020:1.source_cn: 就是那次搁浅，您留我们在海滩上修船，才让我产生了“这样...
say:27:1223109020:1.male: We were stranded on the beach and you left us to repair your ship. That's when it occurred to me that maybe living honestly wasn't such a bad idea.
say:27:1223109020:1.female: We were stranded on the beach and you left us to repair your ship. That's when it occurred to me that maybe living honestly wasn't such a bad idea.

say:28:1223109021:1.text: The gentle breeze and the coconuts falling on my head at that sunny beach... I realized then that a life without violence could be nice too.
say:28:1223109021:1.source_cn: 那时候的阳光，沙滩，海风，还有砸在头上的椰子……让人感...
say:28:1223109021:1.male: The gentle breeze and the coconuts falling on my head at that sunny beach... I realized then that a life without violence could be nice too.
say:28:1223109021:1.female: The gentle breeze and the coconuts falling on my head at that sunny beach... I realized then that a life without violence could be nice too.

say:29:1223109022:1.text: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!
say:29:1223109022:1.source_cn: 毫不夸张地说，是您给了我重新开始的希望！
say:29:1223109022:1.male: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!
say:29:1223109022:1.female: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!

choice_prompt:30:1223109022.text: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!
choice_prompt:30:1223109022.source_cn: 毫不夸张地说，是您给了我重新开始的希望！
choice_prompt:30:1223109022.male: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!
choice_prompt:30:1223109022.female: You inspired me to start afresh! I really mean it!

say:31:1223109023:1.text: After the Dead Tide Fleet was wiped out, we thought we'd soon be finished. We didn't expect the Carmine Whispers would give us a chance to change our ways.
say:31:1223109023:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队全灭后，本来以为我们也玩完了。没想到血薇帮愿意...
say:31:1223109023:1.male: After the Dead Tide Fleet was wiped out, we thought we'd soon be finished. We didn't expect the Carmine Whispers would give us a chance to change our ways.
say:31:1223109023:1.female: After the Dead Tide Fleet was wiped out, we thought we'd soon be finished. We didn't expect the Carmine Whispers would give us a chance to change our ways.

say:32:1223109024:1.text: We wanted to see if a stable, down-to-earth lifestyle was for us.
say:32:1223109024:1.source_cn: 我们也想试试，能不能过上那种踏踏实实的生活。
say:32:1223109024:1.male: We wanted to see if a stable, down-to-earth lifestyle was for us.
say:32:1223109024:1.female: We wanted to see if a stable, down-to-earth lifestyle was for us.

say:33:1223109025:1.text: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?
say:33:1223109025:1.source_cn: 我们还可以重新开始吗？
say:33:1223109025:1.male: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?
say:33:1223109025:1.female: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?

choice_prompt:34:1223109025.text: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?
choice_prompt:34:1223109025.source_cn: 我们还可以重新开始吗？
choice_prompt:34:1223109025.male: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?
choice_prompt:34:1223109025.female: Do we still have the chance to start our lives over?

say:35:1223109026:1.text: Thanks to Sinbad, we've learned that even the worst of villains can have a fresh start in their lives.
say:35:1223109026:1.source_cn: 多亏了辛巴达，他让我们明白，就算是再恶劣的坏蛋，都能有...

say:38:1223109027:0.text: This isn't a good analogy—Sinbad's never been as corrupted as you are. He's just... cunning and dishonest.
say:38:1223109027:0.source_cn: 这个比喻不合适，辛巴达没干过像你们这样的坏事，他只是…...

say:39:1223109028:0.text: If Sinbad were here, he'd say—
say:39:1223109028:0.source_cn: 要是辛巴达在，他应该会说——

choice_prompt:40:1223109028.text: If Sinbad were here, he'd say—
choice_prompt:40:1223109028.source_cn: 要是辛巴达在，他应该会说——

say:41:1223109029:1.text: Fine. I just wanted to ask—since you were able to help Sinbad get his life back on track, could we have your guidance too?
say:41:1223109029:1.source_cn: 好吧，我只是想说，既然您可以帮辛巴达找到人生的新方向什...

say:42:1223109030:1.text: Maybe our change could set a positive example for other thugs!

say:44:1223109031:0.text: Truth be told, I used to be in charge of recruiting new members for my gang, so I'm pretty good with words.
say:44:1223109031:0.source_cn: 实不相瞒，以前我专门负责拉新水鬼入伙，嘴皮子功夫还行。
say:44:1223109031:0.male: Truth be told, I used to be in charge of recruiting new members for my gang, so I'm pretty good with words.

say:45:1223109032:1.text: By turning us into well-behaved citizens with jobs, Rustport's future safety can be guaranteed. It's an alternative way to subdue us!
say:45:1223109032:1.source_cn: 让我们变成有工作的良民，就相当于为了锈锚港的未来，用另...
say:45:1223109032:1.male: By turning us into well-behaved citizens with jobs, Rustport's future safety can be guaranteed. It's an alternative way to subdue us!
say:45:1223109032:1.female: By turning us into well-behaved citizens with jobs, Rustport's future safety can be guaranteed. It's an alternative way to subdue us!

say:46:1223109033:1.text: The thing is, the people here are traumatized by you. Starting your new life here will likely be an uphill battle.
say:46:1223109033:1.source_cn: 问题是这里的居民光看到你们的脸，就被吓死了，你们的新生...

say:47:1223109034:1.text: Well, we'll do it one step at a time. Just like fishing, it requires patience.
say:47:1223109034:1.source_cn: 走一步看一步呗，就像钓鱼，也需要耐心。

say:48:1223109035:1.text: Anyway, no monkey business is allowed! Chippy will be watching you closely!
say:48:1223109035:1.source_cn: 总之，不许干坏事！满满会盯着你们的！

say:49:1223109036:1.text: I swear—if we're up to no good again, we'll have sores on our mouths and tongues and never get to taste Rustport's galefish again!
say:49:1223109036:1.source_cn: 我发誓，如果我们再有歹心，就让我们口舌生疮，再也吃不到...

say:50:1223109037:0.text: We'll be hanging around the market. Feel free to check on us!
say:50:1223109037:0.source_cn: 我们会一直在集市这里活动，欢迎你们来监督！

choice:40:1:2.source_cn: 我不想尝试他的思考逻辑！

choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 做好被报复的心理准备

say:0:1223110001:0.male: Magister, Chippy foresees a lot of drama ahead.
say:0:1223110001:0.female: Magister, Chippy foresees a lot of drama ahead.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1223101003:.text: The Water Wights are taking our stuff!

say:5:1223102001:0.text: It's the Water Wights again! They're back! Run!
say:5:1223102001:0.source_cn: 水鬼又来抢东西了！快跑啊！

say:6:1223102002:0.text: Don't worry. We Carmine Whispers are here.

say:7:1223102003:0.text: We'll crush their heads if they stir up trouble again!
say:7:1223102003:0.source_cn: 如果他们还敢乱来，就碾碎他们的脑袋！

say:15:1223102006:0.text: Can't believe the Water Wights are still up to no good!
say:15:1223102006:0.male: Can't believe the Water Wights are still up to no good!
say:15:1223102006:0.female: Can't believe the Water Wights are still up to no good!

say:16:1223102007:0.text: Magister, let's find out what's going on!
say:16:1223102007:0.source_cn: 主人，我们也去看看热闹吧！
say:16:1223102007:0.male: Magister, let's find out what's going on!
say:16:1223102007:0.female: Magister, let's find out what's going on!

narration:19:12050112:0.text: You witness the residents of Rustport plead for help from Knox.
narration:19:12050112:0.source_cn: 你目睹锈锚港的居民向血薇帮诺克求救。

say:9:1223104002:0.text: Sir Chippy won't allow you to wreak havoc here!
say:9:1223104002:0.source_cn: 仓鼠骑士满满，不允许你们在这为非作歹！

say:10:1223104003:0.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

say:15:1223104004:0.text: Are you trying to steal our business? My pistol's been itching to shoot someone!
say:15:1223104004:0.source_cn: 想抢生意？老子手里的枪可不让！

say:16:1223104005:0.text: Oh, really? Well, my fists have been aching to pummel some ugly faces!

narration:18:12050113:0.text: You follow Knox to the scene and find the Water Wights carrying things.
narration:18:12050113:0.source_cn: 你跟着血薇帮诺克赶到现场，果然发现水鬼帮的人在搬运货物。
